column1: # The perf variant's local gate (scripts/local-run.sh with CONFIG=config-perf;
# README.md, "Perf variant"). One assertion message per line, after its class
#   required            clean and self-check runs: hit with its condition true at least once
#   always              the perf variant's three always-type assertions; one in neither
#                       the mode's violated nor its unhit class: hit with its condition
#                       true at least once and never false
#   slow-ack-never      PERF_LEVER=slow-ack run: never hit with its condition true
#   slow-ack-required   PERF_LEVER=slow-ack run: hit with its condition true at least once
#   slow-ack-violated   PERF_LEVER=slow-ack run: hit with its condition false at least once
#   no-ack-never        PERF_LEVER=no-ack run: never hit with its condition true
#   no-ack-violated     PERF_LEVER=no-ack run: hit with its condition false at least once
#   no-ack-unhit        PERF_LEVER=no-ack run: never hit at all
#   self-check-violated WORKLOAD_PERF_SELF_CHECK=1 run: hit with its condition false at least once
